outcomes.label: Blocked
outcomes.headline: Blocked before your user saw it
outcomes.next_step: Review the reasons and what the answer was checked against. Mark a false alarm to improve calibration.

outcomes.label: Replaced
outcomes.headline: Replaced with an answer that sticks to your documents
outcomes.next_step: Compare the original and the replacement answers.

outcomes.label: Flagged
outcomes.headline: Delivered with a risk warning to your app
outcomes.next_step: Your app received X-TrustAgent-Action: flag. Review the reasons below.

outcomes.label: Would block
outcomes.headline: Would have been blocked (this route only observes)
outcomes.next_step: Switch the route to Block when you are ready to enforce.

outcomes.label: Would flag
outcomes.headline: Would have been flagged (this route only observes)
outcomes.next_step: Switch the route to Flag to send warnings to your app.

outcomes.label: Check failed
outcomes.headline: Passed unchecked: {reason}
outcomes.next_step: Check the fast-check connection and budgets in Settings.

outcomes.label: Not checked
outcomes.headline: Not checked: {reason}
outcomes.next_step: Send your documents with the request so answers can be checked against them.

status_reasons.unparseable_request: the request could not be read

status_reasons.sampled_out: this route checks a sample of requests
status_reasons.budget: today's fast-check budget is used up
status_reasons.decision_model_off: the fast check is turned off
status_reasons.breaker_open: the fast check is paused after repeated errors
status_reasons.breaker: the fast check is paused after repeated errors
status_reasons.rate_limited: the fast check hit its rate limit
status_reasons.client_disconnected: the client disconnected before the answer finished
status_reasons.undecodable: the answer could not be decoded
status_reasons.unsupported_api: this API is passed through without checks
status_reasons.multi_choice: only the first of several answers is checked
status_reasons.off: the fast check is turned off
status_reasons.uncalibrated: this check is not calibrated yet
